verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents Radar using data from other Stripe merchants, such as a card or identity seen elsewhere, in its risk scoring. The closest item, the related-payments network in risk insights, explicitly covers only payments 'made to your business' using the same customer ID, IP address or card. That is a single-merchant view, not cross-merchant intelligence. The axis clearly applies to a fraud-scoring product, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, scoring benefits from a cross-merchant network — a card or identity seen across thousands of other businesses informs the risk decision on mine
